program:
PARAMS = {
    "W1": (50.0, 16.0, 100.0),   # diff-pair width (um)
    "L1": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # diff-pair length
    "W3": (20.0, 8.0, 40.0),     # PMOS mirror load width
    "L3": (0.75, 0.5, 1.5),      # PMOS mirror / M7 length
    "Wb": (8.0, 3.0, 16.0),      # NMOS unit current-source width
    "Lb": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "mt": (8, 5, 12),            # tail mirror ratio (x Iref)
    "m8": (30, 18, 45),          # output-stage current ratio (x Iref)
    "Cc": (2.2e-12, 1.2e-12, 3.5e-12),
    "Rz": (800.0, 300.0, 3000.0),
}

def _vgs_for(lut, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.1, 1.79
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    ib = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    mt = int(round(p["mt"])); m8 = int(round(p["m8"]))
    W1, L1, W3, L3, Wb, Lb = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["W3"], p["L3"], p["Wb"], p["Lb"]
    Cc, Rz = p["Cc"], p["Rz"]
    itail = mt * ib; i1 = itail / 2; i7 = m8 * ib
    W7 = W3 * i7 / i1          # same L and Vsg as mirror -> no systematic offset

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias diode sinks IREF, mirrored to tail and output sink
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lb)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lb, m=mt)
    # diff pair: vinp drives the stage-1 output side (o1) -> overall non-inverting
    n.M("M1", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.M("M2", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    # PMOS mirror load
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W3, L3)
    n.M("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W3, L3)
    # second stage
    n.M("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W7, L3)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lb, m=m8)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---------- first-order predictions ----------
    vgsb = _vgs_for(lut, "n", Wb, Lb, ib, vds=0.6)
    vgs1 = _vgs_for(lut, "n", W1, L1, i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    vtail = vcm - vgs1
    op1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vgs1, 0.6, max(vtail, 0.0))
    vsg3 = _vgs_for(lut, "p", W3, L3, i1, vds=0.8)
    op3 = lut.op("p", W3, L3, vsg3, vsg3)
    op4 = op3
    op7 = lut.op("p", W7, L3, vsg3, vdd / 2)
    opb = lut.op("n", Wb, Lb, vgsb, vdd / 2)
    gm1, gds1 = op1["gm"], op1["gds"]
    gm3 = op3["gm"]; gds4 = op4["gds"]
    gm7, gds7 = op7["gm"], op7["gds"]
    gds8 = m8 * opb["gds"]
    A1 = gm1 / (gds1 + gds4)
    A2 = gm7 / (gds7 + gds8)
    gain_db = 20 * math.log10(A1 * A2)
    wu = gm1 / Cc
    ugbw = wu / (2 * PI)
    C1 = op7.get("cgg", 0.5e-12) + 0.05e-12
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * (Cc + cl) + Cc * cl)
    rz_eff = Rz - 1.0 / gm7
    zphase = math.degrees(math.atan(wu * Cc * rz_eff)) if rz_eff > 0 else -math.degrees(math.atan(-wu * Cc * rz_eff))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) + zphase
    pm = min(pm, 89.0)
    power = vdd * (ib + itail + i7)
    vdsat7 = op7.get("vdsat", 0.15); vdsat8 = opb.get("vdsat", 0.12)
    swing = vdd - vdsat7 - vdsat8 - 0.1
    slew = min(itail / Cc, i7 / (cl + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / wu
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + gm3 / gm1))
    noise_1k = 4 * noise_th
    return n, {
        "gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
        "swing": swing, "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise_1k,
        "cmrr_db": 60.0, "psrr_db": 55.0,
    }
